reason: You're asking me to pipe our GitHub, Slack, Drive and Teams into a hosted service that's in early preview, from a company I've never heard of. That won't get through my own security review, never mind procurement, and at $20 a seat across 300+ engineers I can't show finance a concrete saving.
objection: Will this company still exist in two years, and who's on the hook when a preview-stage vendor holding every incident, decision and line of context from our code leaks or gets acquired? I'd want SOC 2, a DPA, data residency and a real support contract before I'd even open a ticket.
would_change_my_mind: A SOC 2 Type II report and a paying reference customer my size, plus self-hosting that runs fully inside our VPC. Then I might pilot the free MIT version with one platform team and only pay if it measurably cuts incident time or bad agent changes.
